context: Daichi tells Mei about a trip to India.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: travel chat; vocabulary (インド/沖縄/里/突然/大量) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 若い頃、インドを旅したんよ。
lines.en: When I was young, I traveled India.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty nostalgic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: インドは、どんな所でしたか?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 大量の人と、色に圧倒されたわ。
lines.en: I was overwhelmed by the masses of people and colors.
lines.style: animated Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 突然、何か困ったことは?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 突然の雨で、大量に濡れたわ。
lines.en: A sudden rain soaked me thoroughly.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 故郷の里が、恋しくなりましたか?
lines.en: Did you miss your home village?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 里の景色を、よう思い出したわ。
lines.en: I often recalled my village's scenery.
lines.style: nostalgic Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今度は、沖縄にも行きたいですね。
lines.en: Next, I'd like to go to Okinawa too.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm closing delivery throughout
